placeholders.1: WARDEN · Dependency-trust gate · A CI dependency-trust gate for both Python ecosystems — PyPI applications and the conda / conda-forge world of scientific, analytics & ML/AI computing.

1: A gate reduces to one number. 0 merges, non-zero blocks.
exit 0 — assessed & clean — the tool looked hard and found nothing.
exit 0 — never looked — the tool found nothing because it could not check.
Warden refuses to collapse them — an unproven result is never reported as clean.

placeholders.1: If the OSV feed is missing, empty, corrupt, or stale, a naive scanner queries it, gets zero hits, and reports clean. Warden content-pre-flights the database before it trusts a single result.

1: Every engine and axis merges into one ComplianceReport, schema-validated.
Producer-agnostic — the source of truth, not the log.
Carries coverage and provenance per axis.
Versioned schema — the contract cannot silently drift.

placeholders.1: The whole design turns on one placement: indeterminate sits above the pass line. An unproven axis fails the gate — it never slides down to clean.
